opportunity: A call's TRAILING register argument can be a value a previous call's clobber left behind: Heritage::guard_calls plants an INDIRECT creation for a killed-by-call register that is also a possible OUTPUT location of the callee's model (rdx on x86-64, because a 16-byte value returns in rax:rdx), AncestorRealistic::enter_node answers realistic for it and records ind_create_formed, and fillin_map_standard marks every active trial used. Upstream reads that bit back on the RETURN list only (fillin_map_standard_out), so the evidence that disqualifies a return value is ignored for an argument. coreutils fmt -O2 main renders sub_3700(stdin,"-",v10) against a DWARF prototype of two parameters, with two `// rdx` locals that are never assigned.
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-argclobber.xml (3 two-pass assertions on a hand-assembled x86-64 bytechunk) + tests/stages/kuna-argclobber-guards.xml (the callee-reads clause, x86-64) + tests/stages/kuna-argclobber-armreturn.xml (the same-register clause, ARM, the u-boot repro reduced)
inspiration: upstream ParamListStandardOut::fillinMap (fspec.cc:1721) applied to the input list; witness coreutils fmt -O2 main 0x26a0 -> fmt 0x3700 at 0x2ac1
root_cause: Not a kuna scheduling divergence and not the is_checked() guard. Instrumented (KUNA_DBG_TRIAL) on the witness call: the RDX trial is checked on ActionActiveParam pass 0, the three-input MULTIEQUAL already exists at that point, AncestorRealistic returns realistic=1 solid=0 and sets ind_create_formed=1, and the trial is active+used from then on. The bit IS set (contradicting the refuter's inference, which mis-anchored fspec.rs:3249/:3264-3267 to fillin_map_standard; those lines are inside fillin_map_standard_out, fn at :3235). The input list simply has no reader of the bit, faithfully to upstream: stock Ghidra emits the same three-argument call on the same binary and names the phantoms extraout_RDX/extraout_RDX_00.

witness.before: v12 = sub_3700(stdin,"-",v10);  /  v3 = sub_3700(stdin,v6);  /  v12 &= sub_3700(v5);   (3/2/1 arguments, `unsigned long v9; // rdx` and `unsigned long v11; // rdx` never assigned)
witness.after: v9 = sub_3700(stdin,"-");  /  v3 = sub_3700(stdin,v6);  /  v9 &= sub_3700(v5,v6);   (2/2/2, DWARF says fmt(FILE *, char const *))

corpus_sweep.method: kuna decompile-all, whole binary, option off vs on, per-function diff with vN renumbering normalized; every changed call group then classified against the callee's OWN recovered prototype arity. Artifact: docs/features/phantomargs/sweep-2026-09-16.txt
corpus_sweep.shape: every changed site loses exactly one TRAILING argument (3->2, or 2->1 on ARM). No call site appears or disappears, no statement moves, no control-flow change.
corpus_sweep.ground_truth: at every changed site the arity landed on is the arity of the callee's own recovered prototype. The three named imports are confirmed against DWARF on the unstripped twins: xrealloc(void *, size_t), ext2fs_dblist_sort2(dblist, sortfunc), e2fsck_use_inode_shortcuts(ctx, bool). u-boot's two are get_ticks (0 params) and sub_6086752c (1 param, 60+ other sites pass 1). betaflight's sub_8032628 is called with one argument at ~40 other sites.
corpus_sweep.false_positive_avoided: tar parse_datetime2 @0x48e10 -> str_days @0x46550 (DWARF: 3 params). Its RDX trial is MULTIEQUAL(COPY, MULTIEQUAL) -- the clobber is one phi deeper -- so the direct-clobber clause declines it and the real argument is kept.
corpus_sweep.option_off_is_inert: kuna decompile-all with the option OFF is byte-identical to the pinned main binary on all 8 binaries the option changes (fmt, grep, u-boot, ssh-keygen, dpkg, e2fsck, betaflight, bash): 0 differing lines each.

ground_truth_check.method: readelf --debug-dump=info on the unstripped decbench twin, DW_TAG_formal_parameter count at the callee's DW_AT_low_pc
ground_truth_check.fmt 0x3700: fmt, 2 params (kuna rendered 3 at one site)
ground_truth_check.grep 0xb420: 2 params (kuna rendered 3 at four sites; the option drops two of them and clauses 2 and 7 decline the other two)
ground_truth_check.tar 0x46550: str_days, 3 params (declined by the direct-clobber clause)
ground_truth_check.u-boot 0x60871420: get_ticks, 0 params (readelf on the decbench O2/u-boot twin)
ground_truth_check.u-boot 0x608715f0: __udelay, 1 formal parameter `usec` -- the second parameter kuna recovered was fabricated, and the option removes it
ground_truth_check.u-boot 0x6086752c: 1 parameter by kuna's own recovery; 60+ other call sites in the image pass one
ground_truth_check.u-boot 0x60873270 / 0x6086b998 / 0x60866: printf and two readers of the argument register -- all declined, see review_counterexamples_closed

benchmark.method: kuna decompile-all --addr <fn> --json, variables[] rows (kind, stack_offset, size, type) compared off vs on, on ALL 45 functions the sweep changes. The earlier claim that this is structurally zero was wrong and the review was right to falsify it: the pass can delete a `kind: arg` row when the dropped argument was the caller's own parameter's only use.

changed_rows.u-boot 0x608715f0: one `kind: arg` row removed (unsigned int, 4 bytes): the prototype narrows from (uint4, unsigned int) to (uint4). DWARF says __udelay takes ONE parameter, so this is a type_match GAIN, not a loss.
changed_rows.bash 0xe30d0 (expand_prompt): one `kind: stack` row at -160 goes undefined8 -> char *. DWARF for expand_prompt declares its fbreg locals at -168 and -176, so -160 is a spill slot; the change replaces an untyped 8-byte slot with a typed pointer.

speed.method: interleaved off/on pairs, MINIMUM of 21 pairs, `kuna decompile-all <bin> --addr <fn> --option argclobber off|on` (the CLI surface that rejects a bad option value). Re-measured after the review clauses landed; the box was running the workspace suite throughout, so these are pessimistic.
speed.why: with the option off the first statement returns on a bool. With it on the added work is two reads of an already-built summary: the same-register test walks one join's inputs, and the callee test is a lookup in the per-image CalleeEntryDead map calleedeadarg (default on) already populates. The control binary's +0.40% is the measurement floor on a loaded box.

clauses: the clobber reaches the call directly: the defining op is the indirect creation, or a MULTIEQUAL one of whose immediate inputs is one

every one of those indirect creations is a creation of THE ARGUMENT REGISTER ITSELF (added after review; the first return register of every ABI is also killed-by-call and a possible output location, so a preceding call's result is an indirect creation too)
the callee's own body does not read those register bytes before writing them (CalleeEntryDead::proves_input; added after review)
trailing: no used trial follows it
at least one used argument remains
no already-final sibling call to the same callee entry in this function passed an argument in that storage

review_counterexamples_closed.u-boot 0x60827fa4 -> printf 0x60873270 (: declined by the same-register clause: the creations are at r0, the return of ofnode_read_u32_default, carried into r3 by predicated movs. Also declined by the callee clause (printf proves_input(r3)).
review_counterexamples_closed.u-boot 0x6085512c -> printf 0x60873270 (: declined by the same-register clause (creation at r0) and by the callee clause.
review_counterexamples_closed.u-boot 0x6080b504 -> sub_6086609c (r1): declined by the same-register clause (creation at r0) and by the callee clause; the `if (*p == 0x2f) p = &p[1];` guard the drop had deleted is back.
review_counterexamples_closed.u-boot 0x6083af40 -> sub_6086b998 (r2): declined by the same-register clause (creation at r0, strlen's return) and by the callee clause (sub_6086b998 reads r2 before writing it).
review_counterexamples_closed.u-boot 0x608715f0 -> sub_60871420 (r1): STILL FIRES, and it is correct: readelf on the decbench u-boot twin says 0x60871420 is get_ticks, DW_TAG_formal_parameter count 0, and 0x608715f0 is __udelay with ONE formal parameter (`usec`). The `kind: arg` row the review saw deleted was itself fabricated; the narrowed prototype matches DWARF.
review_counterexamples_closed.unmodelled-variadic callee (the required: answered structurally by the callee clause, not by a per-function scan: u-boot's printf spills r1-r3 into the va_list save area, so proves_input holds for every one of its 1,924 sites at once.

ablation: MEASURED, not asserted: with the default flipped to `true` in Architecture and ArchContext and the tree rebuilt, `kuna test --datatests --baseline docs/baseline.json` is 675/675 PARITY OK and `--datatests-dir tests/stages --baseline docs/baseline-stages.json` is 1018/1018 PARITY OK. The flip was reverted; the shipped default is off, and it is off because of the rax:rdx return shape no clause can see, not because of the corpora.
